502:t_1:3.en: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

502:t_1:4.en:
$$クィーン$$
「...It seems you're all gathered.」

502:t_1:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As always, it's a one-sided call.」

502:t_1:6.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I receive reports on your movements one by one, so there's no need for you to report to me.」

502:t_1:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「It seems the third $$クロノ$$ has a decent organization behind it, too.」

502:t_1:8.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Though with no forces I can move myself, I have no choice but to rely on you.」

502:t_1:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「So what information are you giving us today?」

502:t_1:10.en:
$$クィーン$$
「About Side 1, where you're headed next...」

502:t_1:11.en:
$$クィーン$$
「$$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$, who fell into the hands of the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives, is there.」

502:t_1:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「But she was supposed to have been captured by the $$サイデリアル$$...!」

502:t_1:14.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I imagine the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives took her over to use in their operation.」

502:t_1:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It can't be a coincidence that she's on Side 1.」

502:t_1:16.en:
$$クィーン$$
「It seems the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives learned of your movements and prepared her as a means to intercept you.」

502:t_1:17.en:
$$クィーン$$
「To show their loyalty to the $$サイデリアル$$, they eliminate anyone in the way... or something like that, I suppose.」

502:t_1:18.en:
$$オットー$$
「In other words, they'll use Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン$$ to set some kind of trap...!?」

502:t_1:19.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That's all the information I have. Now... let me see what you can do.」

502:t_1:20.en:
$$オットー$$
「Honestly...! She's as selfish as ever!」

502:t_1:21.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Still, it's useful information again this time. If we had gone straight at Side 1 without knowing, we would have simply walked into the enemy's trap.」

502:t_1:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「But what do we do? Since we can't tell what $$クロノ$$ is up to, we can't very well send in an infiltration team either...」

502:t_1:23.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Then how about deliberately walking into the enemy's scheme?」

502:t_1:25.en:
$$オットー$$
「If we did something that foolish...」

502:t_1:27.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we're going to do it anyway, let's send in the biggest fool we can, one who will stun the enemy.」

502:t_1:33.en:
$$グエン$$
「Please, it's time to let go of your bad mood, Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン$$.」

502:t_1:34.en:
$$グエン$$
「No... With the $$地球連邦$$ government all but collapsed now, it isn't fitting to call you by your post.」

502:t_1:35.en:
$$グエン$$
「Allow me to call you Queen $$リリーナ$$ here.」

502:t_1:37.en:
$$グエン$$
「My name is $$グエン・サード・ラインフォード$$. I come from the $$ＵＣＷ$$, and I now serve as an agent of $$クロノ$$.」

502:t_1:38.en:
$$グエン$$
「Incidentally, it's pointless to ask me about $$クロノ$$'s organization. After all, I'm a newcomer.」

502:t_1:39.en:
$$グエン$$
「Which is why I'm the one assigned to do the legwork like this.」

502:t_1:40.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「That name... I take it you come from a long-established family, but are you not aware that you are behaving shamefully?」

502:t_1:41.en:
$$グエン$$
「Of course I am. Using a hostage is the lowest of schemes.」

502:t_1:42.en:
$$グエン$$
「I consider it my talent that I can do it even while aware of that.」

502:t_1:43.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「What kind of person are you...!」

502:t_1:44.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「Watch your words, ex-queen. Right now you're not some government bigwig, you're just bait.」

502:t_1:45.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「I am $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$.」

502:t_1:46.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「That look...! Sure enough, queens are always the type that rub me the wrong way!」

502:t_1:47.en:
$$グエン$$
「Enough, $$メリーベル$$. We may be the lowest of people, but lacking even basic courtesy is not good.」

502:t_1:49.en:
$$グエン$$
「Forgive my companion, Queen $$リリーナ$$.」

502:t_1:50.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Do you really think I have any value as a hostage, with no 《$$サンクキングダム$$》 left and no longer even holding the post of Vice Foreign Minister?」

502:t_1:51.en:
$$グエン$$
「You're too modest. I'm well aware that your name carries strong influence over both Earth and the colonies.」

502:t_1:52.en:
$$グエン$$
「Above all, now that you're here, the members of $c won't stay quiet.」

502:t_1:54.en:
$$グエン$$
「We learned of their movements and hurriedly brought you here.」

502:t_1:55.en:
$$グエン$$
「Though from here on, it won't be us agents but the action unit that moves.」

502:t_1:56.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Do you intend to use me as a hostage to force them to surrender?」

502:t_1:57.en:
$$グエン$$
「The operation is not something I know about. ...The action unit's member should be arriving about now, so please ask him for the details.」

502:t_1:58.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Wait. You said earlier that you're a newcomer. For what purpose did you become a member of $$クロノ$$?」

502:t_1:59.en:
$$グエン$$
「I'm aware it's rude to answer a question with a question, but what do you intend to do once you hear it?」

502:t_1:60.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Whatever the reason, I will use every word I have to persuade you to give it up.」

502:t_1:61.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「This woman still doesn't seem to understand her position!」

502:t_1:62.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Even if I fall, they... $c will stop you.」

502:t_1:63.en:
$$グエン$$
「I see... I understand how you feel.」

502:t_1:64.en:
$$グエン$$
「I know some of them, after all.」

502:t_1:66.en:
$$グエン$$
「Time's up, Queen $$リリーナ$$. Allow me to wish you good luck.」

502:t_1:67.en:
$$グエン$$
「If you should happen to meet $$ロラン・セアック$$ of $c, please tell him that $$グエン$$ sends his regards.」

502:t_1:68.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「Bye-bye, Your Majesty. Make sure you do a good job as bait.」

502:t_1:72.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! Have you come to rescue me!?」

502:t_1:73.en:
$$リディ$$
「...Don't misunderstand. I'm the one who will be using you.」

502:t_1:75.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm no longer with $c. I am the captain of the $$クロノ$$ action unit.」

502:t_2:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「...So a force that small couldn't stop $$ヒイロ$$ and the others after all.」

502:t_2:4.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Wait, Ensign $$リディ$$! Are you going to fight!?」

502:t_2:6.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Against $c... against your former comrades!?」

502:t_2:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$リリーナ・ピースクラフト$$... the last queen of the fallen $$サンクキングダム$$...」

502:t_2:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「Just as you carried on your late father's will, I will simply fulfill the duty of the $$マーセナス家$$... my role as a member of $$クロノ$$.」

502:t_2:12.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「The $$マーセナス家$$ is a member of $$クロノ$$...」
